name: National Immunization Schedule, Universal Immunization Programme
publisher: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW), National Health Mission

population.description: Pregnant women (the national schedule also covers infants and children, which this app does not assess)

scope_note: India's national public-programme schedule covers infants, children, adolescents and pregnant women. It does not set a routine schedule for other adults, so this app only assesses Td vaccination in pregnancy for India.
status_note: The published schedule document is undated. The Td for pregnant women schedule follows the earlier TT schedule, as MoHFW states in its Td FAQ.
